newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE KEEP HOPES ALIVE WITH RAPID WIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FENERBAHCE KEEP HOPES ALIVE WITH RAPID WIN.

text.p: Turkey's Fenerbahce kept their quarter-final hopes alive by beating Austrians Rapid Vienna 1-0 in their European Cup Champions' League group C match on Wednesday.
In a tight game that both teams needed to win to stand any realistic chance of qualifying, Fenerbahce were denied a first-half lead by a number of good saves from Rapid goalkeeper Michael Konsel.
After sustained pressure in the second half, the Turkish club scored a well deserved goal from Danish defender Jes Hogh in the 75th minute.
Fenerbahce's Nigerian defender Uche Okechukwu headed a long cross from Erol Bulut onto the bar and the rebound landed in front of Hogh, who headed it from close range.
